newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan coffee prices surge to highest since 1994.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan coffee prices surge to highest since 1994.

text.p: Prices surged to their highest since 1994 on Wednesday with strong world demand and a general shortage in consuming countries, auction officials said.

"Panic buying by consumer countries pushed prices up by about $22," a trader said. Traders said the surge reflected prices on the New York terminal market, fuelled by a state workers strike in Colombia.

Grade Cs averaged $230.5 per 50-kg bags from $206.5 while grade AAs averaged $244.5 from $219. The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold all 35,514 60-kg bags on offer (30,511 bags sold at last week). --Wambui Chege, Nairobi Newsroom ++254-2 330-261
